# REHAB FACTORY

> Premium Allied Health, Physiotherapy, Exercise Physiology & Injury Rehabilitation in Narre Warren, Victoria.

## Overview
Rehab Factory provides evidence-based, goal-driven physical therapy, exercise physiology, manual therapy, and return-to-work/sport rehabilitation. We specialize in diagnosing complex musculoskeletal conditions, post-surgical recovery, chronic pain management, and athletic performance optimization.

## Key Information
- **Location**: 9/25-35 Cranbourne Road, Narre Warren VIC 3805, Australia
- **Phone**: 0428 046 819
- **Email**: admin@rehabfactory.com.au
- **Website**: https://rehabfactory.com.au
- **Sitemap**: https://rehabfactory.com.au/sitemap.xml

## Core Services
- **Individualised Exercise Therapy**: Customised strength, mobility, and progressive loading programs for injury recovery and long-term joint health.
- **Manual Therapy**: Hands-on joint mobilization, soft tissue release, dry needling, and sports taping for immediate pain relief and range-of-motion restoration.
- **Return to Work & Sport**: High-level biomechanical assessments, speed/agility restoration, and WorkCover/TAC certified rehabilitation.
- **Patient Education & Health Strategy**: Comprehensive biomechanical breakdowns and self-management toolkits.

## Conditions Treated
- Lower Back & Lumbar Pain
- Neck & Cervical Spine Stiffness
- Knee Injuries (ACL, Meniscus, Patellofemoral Pain)
- Shoulder Pain (Rotator Cuff, Impingement, Dislocation)
- Ankle & Foot Injuries (Sprains, Achilles Tendinopathy)
- Post-Surgical Rehabilitation (Reconstruction, Joint Replacement)
- Sports & Athletic Performance Injuries
- WorkCover & TAC Workplace/Traffic Incident Injuries
